name: submit_video
description:
Submit a video generation job and create a video asset in the project library. This tool does not place generated video on the timeline; after the job completes, use track_progress to get the asset id and edit_item to place it. Split project references by asset type before calling: images -> refImages, videos -> refVideos, audios -> refAudios. For single-shot generation, pass prompt. For Kling customize multi-shot, omit prompt and pass model:kling, shotType:customize, and multiPrompts; the tool submits provider params as multiShot:true, shotType:customize, multiPrompt, and prompt:"". See the video-gen skill for model, reference media, duration, and first/last-frame guidance.

If confirmation times out or is cancelled before the user answers, ask the user to retry.

continueFrom.description: model:"omni" only. Project video asset ref (UUID, short prefix, or asset://id), up to 10s. Describe a targeted change for edit, or what happens next with taskMode:"extend". Each result is a NEW asset; preservation is not pixel-exact. The source stays in the library.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in integer seconds: Seedance 2.5 supports 4-30; Seedance 2.0 and MiniMax H3 support 4-15; MiniMax H3 Max supports 5-15; Kling 1-15; Omni 3-10. For Omni extend this specifies added seconds. Prefer a number; simple seconds strings like "8s" are accepted.

firstFrame.description: Strict first-frame image. For Seedance 2 and MiniMax H3, do not combine this with refImages, refVideos, or refAudios. MiniMax H3 Max supports frames but no references. For Omni this is the image_to_video input and cannot be combined with continueFrom. Pass a project image asset id (UUID or short prefix from `browse_assets`), asset://id, or a same-project asset URL.

lastFrame.description: Last-frame image asset id, asset://id, or same-project URL. MiniMax H3 supports a last frame by itself; MiniMax H3 Max, Seedance, Kling, and Omni 1.1 require firstFrame too. Frame mode cannot be combined with reference inputs or continueFrom.

mode.description: Kling quality tier. "std" = 720p, "pro" = 1080p. Defaults to "std". Ignored by Seedance 2.

model.description: Video model alias. Defaults to "seedance-2-5". "minimax-h3" supports 4-15s, 768p/2k, frames and references. "minimax-h3-max" supports 5-15s, 480p/768p and first/last frames only. "omni" is Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with source-video edits/extensions. See video-gen for selection rules.

multiPrompts.description: Kling customize multi-shot storyboard. Use model:kling; shot indexes must be 1-based consecutive; shot durations must sum to durationSeconds. Put shared character/style requirements inside each shot prompt.

duration.description: Shot duration in integer seconds. Prefer a number; simple seconds strings like "3s" are accepted for compatibility.

outputFormat.description: Seedance 2.5 only. Output container: mp4 by default, or mov by default when taskMode is edit/extend and outputFormat is omitted. Omit for other models.

prompt.description: Single top-level video prompt. Required for normal single-shot generation and Kling shotType:intelligence. Do not pass this with Kling shotType:customize; use multiPrompts only, because the provider prompt is intentionally empty.

refAudios.description: Reference audio asset refs only. Seedance 2.5 accepts MP3/WAV, 2-30s each and 30s total, supports up to 10, and allows audio-only references. MiniMax H3 supports 3, 2-15s each and 15s total, including audio-only mode. MiniMax H3 Max does not support references. Seedance 2.0 supports 3 and requires a visual reference. Do not combine with frame inputs.

refImages.description: Reference image asset refs only. Seedance 2.5 supports at most 30; Seedance 2.0 and MiniMax H3 support 9; Omni supports at most 3. MiniMax H3 Max does not support references. Seedance and H3 frame/reference modes are mutually exclusive.

refVideos.description: Reference video asset refs only. Seedance 2.5 supports at most 10; Seedance 2.0 and MiniMax H3 support 3. H3 clips must be 2-15s each and 15s total. MiniMax H3 Max does not support references. Do not combine with firstFrame/lastFrame.

resolution.description: Output resolution. MiniMax H3: 768p by default or 2k. MiniMax H3 Max: 480p or 768p by default. Omni: 360p/720p/1080p/4k. Seedance: 480p/720p/1080p; mini/fast: 480p/720p. Kling uses mode instead.

shotType.description: Kling multi-shot mode. Use "customize" with multiPrompts for per-shot control, or "intelligence" with one top-level prompt for auto decomposition.

taskMode.description: Seedance 2.5 or Omni task intent. "edit" inherits source ratio/duration; "extend" generates a continuation using durationSeconds; "generate" creates a new scene. Edit/extend create a NEW asset. Source: refVideos for Seedance 2.5, continueFrom for Omni (omitting taskMode with continueFrom means edit).
